QuestInfo.name: A Scholar's Pride
QuestInfo.0: There is an old, stubborn scholar waiting in the\r\n#bVeritas#k labs. See if he needs anything.
QuestInfo.1:
Professor #b#p2300002##k told you of his time with
#p2154009#, revealing some ill feelings for both
Gelimer and you. He seems upset that a scientist would use his gifts to create weapons of destruction.
Talk to #bPromathus#k again.
QuestInfo.2: Professor #b#p2300002##k seemed to soften his feelings after you talked. He still has some reserves about trusting you, but he seems to be someone you can trust.

0.0: What?\r\n#bI was wondering if you needed any help.#k
0.1: Interesting, you appear to be one of #p2154009#'s... Are you new here?\r\n#bDo you know #p2154009#?#k
0.2: Yes, yes, we worked together for a long time. Excellent biomachinist, nearly limitless intelligence.
0.3: His choice of allegiances was... unfortunate. The Black Wings are not known for being good research partners. We lost touch long ago.
0.4: Rumor had it, he created the ultimate weapon. I am assuming that would be you. As usual, #p2154009# did his work too well, hehehe...
0.5: A scientist must work responsibly, not for personal gain. Any genius who doesn't know that is no genius in my book. Gelimer was a lost cause the moment he took their side.
0.6: I have nothing in particular to say to you.

yes.0: You are nothing but Gelimer's tool for destruction. I have nothing to say to you.

no.0: Didn't I tell you to go away?

1.0: I didn't expect Gelimer's AI to be so dense. Leave!\r\n#L0##bWhy do you dislike me?#l\n#k
1.1: Why do you care? Why is a weapon pretending to be human?\r\n#L0##b...#l\n#k
1.2: Don't just stare at me, robot. I'm starting to feel bad.\r\n#L0##b...#l\n#k
1.3: Fine. I apologize for offending your emotional circuits. Now, leave an old man to his work.

yes.0: Take this. And don't even think about turning into another Gelimer. Be a human first, a scientist second.
